summary: Frontend-only verification of bug fix: tapping on idle room now starts a session IMMEDIATELY (no confirmation Alert), active room shows live timer; tapping active card opens modal with timer/cost/adjust/products/stop; stop and quick-adjust (-5) both work. All critical flows pass.

index.tsx imports Alert still used for error cases (OK).
src/api.ts uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env correctly; all endpoints use /api prefix.

seed_data_creation: None. Started and cleanly stopped sessions on Room 1 during testing; screen left clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified flows on mobile viewport (375x667): (1) idle room-card-1 tap → immediate transition to نشطة with live HH:MM:SS timer and no confirmation dialog; (2) tap active card → bottom sheet modal with timer/cost breakdown/adjust buttons/products/stop button; (3) adjust-back-5 backdates start-time (timer jumped from 00:00:24 to 00:05:27, ~+5 min, as expected); (4) stop-session-btn closes session and card returns to متاحة idle. Sessions cleaned up after tests. Backend was not tested this iteration (per review_request).
rca_of_issue: Original bug: Alert.alert confirm dialog before starting session was unreliable on React Native Web (did not resolve user's intent to start). Fix: handleRoomPress now calls api.startSession(room.id) directly on press for idle rooms and opens details modal for active rooms. Verified working via Playwright on the public Expo web preview.
